start: Profile tab, a member with some finished workouts

steps.action: Tap the Profile tab
user_sees: Title 'Profile', the member's photo and name
Stats 'Workouts', 'Streak' (week or weeks), 'Records'
The history chart and the workout feed
must_not: A skeleton that never ends
'1 weeks' for a one-week streak

steps.action: Pick another chart range
user_sees: The chart for the new range only
must_not: Bars of the old range shown under the new range's name

steps.action: Scroll down the feed to the end
user_sees: More workouts load; each workout once
must_not: The same workout twice in the feed
The feed stopping at a page size with no way to load more

steps.action: Tap one workout card
user_sees: That workout's page opens
must_not: Another workout opens

steps.action: Tap the pencil 'Edit profile'
user_sees: Title 'Your profile'
'Changes save as you type.'
must_not: A Save button that must be pressed or changes lost on back

steps.action: Change the name, wait a moment, press back
user_sees: A short 'Saved' line
Profile shows the new name
must_not: Profile still showing the old name after coming back

steps.action: Open 'Badges' from the Profile
user_sees: Title 'Badges'
Subtitle '<n> of <total> earned'
must_not: A badge shown as earned that the member has not earned

steps.action: Tap the calendar / month counts to open 'Calendar'
user_sees: Title 'Calendar'
'Streak' and 'Rest days' cards
Button 'Log a past workout'
must_not: Rest days counted on a day with a workout

steps.action: Search for a word that matches nothing
user_sees: 'No workouts match “<word>”'
must_not: A blank list with no words

steps.action: Tap 'Charts'
user_sees: 'Last 7 days'
'Sets per muscle group'
'Muscle distribution'
'Main exercises'
'Records' with 'See all'
must_not: A chart range past 3 months opened without the limit check, when the free plan limit is on

steps.action: Tap 'Records'
user_sees: Title 'Records'
Each record with its kind badge
must_not: 'No records yet' when the read failed (must say it could not load)

steps.action: Tap one record
user_sees: That exercise's page
must_not: Another exercise opens

steps.action: Open 'Credits'
user_sees: Title 'Credits'
Subtitle 'Pictures and fonts made by others'
'Read the licence' and 'See the source' links
must_not: A link that opens nothing with no message

steps.action: Clear the name box
user_sees: 'Your name, please.' under the box
must_not: An empty name saved

steps.action: Type a name longer than the limit
user_sees: 'Keep your name under <max> characters.'
must_not: The long name saved or cut without a word

steps.action: Type a bad link
user_sees: The link error under its box
must_not: The bad link saved and opened from the Profile

steps.action: Tap the photo, choose camera, refuse the camera
user_sees: 'Camera not allowed' with 'Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone’s settings, or choose a photo instead.'
must_not: A crash or a blank photo

start: Profile tab, the phone database read fails

steps.action: Open Profile
user_sees: A load error for 'your profile' with a try again
must_not: 'No workouts yet' shown when the read failed
An endless skeleton

steps.action: Bring the app back to the front
user_sees: The failed part is read again by itself
must_not: The error stuck until the app is restarted

start: Profile tab with the progress hint showing

steps.action: Tap 'Got it'
user_sees: The hint note is gone
must_not: The note coming back on the next visit

steps.action: Finish a new workout, return to Profile
user_sees: 'Workouts' count goes up by one; the new workout is first in the feed
must_not: Old counts shown from before the save

steps.action: Delete that workout from its page, return to Profile
user_sees: Count back down; the workout is gone from feed and calendar
must_not: A deleted workout still in the feed, calendar or records

start: Profile tab with a bio and a link

steps.action: Tap 'Share this month as a picture'
user_sees: A picture of the month to share
must_not: The picture showing body weight
The member's phone number on the picture

steps.action: Look at what the gym can see
user_sees: Profile, bio, link and photo stay on this phone (cloud copy only when signed in, own only)
must_not: The gym or another member seeing the bio, link or photo

note: New member: stats 0 and empty feed; long name is one line with dots; no photo shows initials
Streak counts weeks in a row and the calendar groups by day; week start and day edge decide both
Edit profile saves on a timer; back and app-to-background flush it; a swipe-away kill may lose the last typed field
Charts and stats show kg or lb; photo needs the camera
Three stats sit in one row beside the avatar
Old saved chart metric 'sets' is mapped to the default; old history must still show
A workout finished on the watch must reach Profile counts and feed

start: Gym tab, phone in no gym, member has the gym's 6-letter code

steps.action: Tap the Gym tab
user_sees: Title 'Gym'
Card 'Join your gym' with 'Scan the poster' first and 'Or type your gym's code'
'With your gym in the app' list
'No gym? Everything else works without one.'
must_not: A locked row
A blank screen while the gym store loads for ever

steps.action: Type the code, tap 'Next'
user_sees: The invite screen for that gym opens
must_not: A wrong gym opened

steps.action: Confirm 18 or older and the terms, join
user_sees: The Gym tab now shows the gym's name and 'Check in'
must_not: Workouts changed or lost by joining
Joining without the 18+ and terms step

start: Gym tab, no gym, standing at the gym poster

steps.action: Tap 'Scan the poster', point the camera at the poster
user_sees: The join screen for that gym
must_not: A wrong code accepted
The phone's own camera app opened instead of the in-app scanner

start: A friend's invite link forgeai://j/<CODE> or https://forgeai.aakashpahuja.in/j/<CODE>

steps.action: Tap the link on the phone
user_sees: MettleUp opens the invite screen for that gym
must_not: The link opening a browser 404
Another gym's invite screen

start: Joined member at the gym desk

steps.action: On the Gym tab tap 'Check in' ('Scan the gym's check-in QR at the desk to mark today's visit')
user_sees: The in-app scanner opens
must_not: A check-in marked without a scan

steps.action: Scan the desk QR (or open forgeai://c/<CODE>)
user_sees: Today's visit is marked; the member can start today's workout in one tap
must_not: Two visits for one scan
A visit marked at another gym

steps.action: Type 3 letters, tap 'Next'
user_sees: 'The code is 6 letters or numbers. Ask at your gym's desk.'
must_not: The invite screen opened with a bad code

steps.action: Scan a QR that is not a gym poster
user_sees: A plain message that this is not a gym code
must_not: The app opening the strange link

steps.action: Refuse the camera for the scanner
user_sees: A plain reason and the typed-code way still there
must_not: A prompt that comes back on every tap, or a crash

start: Joined member whose gym lets them go

steps.action: The gym removes the member; open the Gym tab
user_sees: The join screen again with the gym's notice why this phone is in no gym
must_not: The old gym's name, shop or check-in still showing
Workouts deleted

steps.action: Join again with the code
user_sees: The gym's home again
must_not: Two member rows for one phone

start: Joined member on the Gym tab

steps.action: Check what the gym gets from joining
user_sees: Name and number the member gave; workouts stay on the phone unless the member shares them
must_not: Body weight, photos or notes sent to the gym
Another gym seeing this member

note: Gym with no logo and a long name in the title; a gym with an empty shop shows 'Your gym has nothing in its shop yet.'
Check-in at 23:59 must land on the right day; member whose plan ends today
Join and check-in need the internet; double tap on join
Join card holds a text box, two buttons and a long caption
A phone joined on an older version (forgeai links) must still show its gym
Join and check-in show on the gym panel
